mathematical_definition: causal_tercile(shannon_entropy_returns_60, 500) -- rolling (trailing, shift(1)) tercile bucket of family D's Shannon entropy of returns (numba-jitted 60-bar histogram entropy), consumed via the merged `upstream` dict (upstream['shannon_entropy_returns_60']) rather than recomputed, which would duplicate family D
numerical_stability_notes: causal_tercile's rolling quantile thresholds are ill-defined (NaN) until min_periods=window//4=125 is satisfied; also inherits shannon_entropy_returns_60's own 60-bar histogram warmup NaN
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first ~125 bars (window//4 min_periods gate on the rolling quantile), plus whatever NaN warmup shannon_entropy_returns_60 itself carries (60-bar histogram window); never zero-filled
